# Migration reference fixtures

Captured directly from the unmodified TypeScript/chess.js implementation at the parent of the Python migration commit.

- `legacy-positions.json`: FEN, sorted legal UCI moves, and SAN recap at every ply of all 45 catalog lines, including the initial position.
- `legacy-sampling.json`: 500 selections using an LCG seeded with 2025 (`seed = (1664525 * seed + 1013904223) mod 2^32`), with the same five-item cooldown as the app.
- `legacy-backup.json`: a version 1 backup produced through the old `recordResult`, `savePreferences`, and `exportBackup` APIs, using synthetic White/Black practice records.

These are immutable behavior references, not snapshots regenerated by the migrated implementation. The fixture data contains no personal progress.
